newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BOURSE SLEEPY, MIXED TRADING SEEN.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE SLEEPY, MIXED TRADING SEEN.

text.p: Trading slowed Thursday morning on Lithuania's stock exchange, as brokers said they expected a sleepy day of mixed trading.
"Today is slower than yesterday," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema. "Everybody is sleeping and prices are mixed."
"We had eight ups, nine downs and four shares that stayed put (on the A list)," Andrejauskas added.
Among the downs were Lithuanian Gas at 1.81 litas from 1.85 litas. Lithuanian Energy was also down at 2.45 litas from 2.50 litas.
"Turnover in Lithuanian Gas is increasing," said Saulius Merkys, a broker with Vilfima.
But brokers said they saw no new developments in energy shares, which often indicate the direction the market is moving in.
Ekranas was among the gainers, edging up to 5.21 litas from 5.10 litas.
"It's quite an interesting company, but it has the same problem as most Lithuanian companies, it needs investment," said Merkys.
Hermis Bank shares slid to 175.10 litas from 178.00 litas. Brokers say the shares are a bargain and will eventally be pushed up by the bank's positive results for the first four months of 1997.
